spec_case: issue #578 with issue #577: a prompt built in a file leaves no copy of its text in state
description: A tool writes the prompt text (which contains `{{...}}`) to a file at run time and prints its path; the prompt reads it at dispatch with `runtime.state.prompt_sent: sha256`, so `meta.prompt_sent` is null and `meta.template_files` carries the file's path, SHA-256 and length. The tool's own `value` is the path, not the text.
